span.p:
GET /search/
product_cate_id, store_id,
name, price_min, price_max

div.style: color: rgb(13, 36, 56) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
color: rgb(13, 36, 56) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(58, 36, 5) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
RandomController@getRandomStore
StoreInfo::inRandomOrder()->limit(4)
SQL: ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT 4

div.style: color: rgb(58, 36, 5) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
color: rgb(58, 36, 5) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
StoreInfoController@search
WHERE name LIKE %v%
AND address LIKE %v%
AND tag LIKE %v%

div.style: color: rgb(58, 36, 5) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
ProductController@readByConditions
equality on cate/store, LIKE on name,
price >= min, price <= max

div.style: color: rgb(58, 36, 5) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
color: rgb(58, 36, 5) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Look::addLook(store_id)
read-side write: find row for today,
count += 1 else insert count = 1

div.style: color: rgb(58, 36, 5) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Look::getLook(store_id)
today = COUNT(rows)
week = SUM(count) over last 7 days

div.style: color: rgb(58, 36, 5) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Collect::getCollect(product_ids)
GROUP BY products_id,
today via whereDate(created_at)

div.style: color: rgb(58, 36, 5) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Collect::getCollectRank(products)
COUNT(*) per products_id,
sortByDesc in PHP

span.p:
The 'pick something for me' feature is a uniform
random sample of 4 rows in SQL. No user history,
no tag or price weighting, no ML, no cache.

div.style: color: rgb(58, 31, 16) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Neither random picker nor /search/ filters on
products.status, so de-listed items can be returned.

div.style: color: rgb(58, 31, 16) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Popularity data exists (look, collect) but is only
ever read back into seller dashboards - it never
feeds the buyer-facing picker.

svg.text: FoodSelector backend - discovery, picking and popularity paths
